Specifications

FOUNDATION

Earthquake resistant, R.C.C.foundation.

STRUCTURE

R.C.C. framed structure.

WALLS

Built with finest quality concrete hollow blocks.

WALL FINISH

Excellent cement mortar plastering and weather coat finish on external walls.Smooth putty finish and emulsion paint on internal wall.

DOORS & WINDOWS

Hardwood front door, moulded panel doors for interiors. Anodized aluminium windows with M.S grills and glass panes.

KITCHEN

Counter with granite top. Stainless steel sink with drain board.

FLOORING

Vitrified tile flooring for apartments, main staircase, ground floor lobby and passages

ELECTRICAL WORK

Three phase(for 3 Bed), single phase(for I&2 bed) power supply with concealed wiring in"PVC conduit controlled by ELCB/MCB. Elegant modular switches of Crabtree equivalent. Split A/C provision in master bedroom.

CABLE T.V

TV and Internet provision in living room and master bedroom.

TELEPHONE

Points for connection in living and master bedroom.

GENERATOR

For lifts, common lights, water pumps etc. Selected points in apartments. One light point in each drawing room, dinning room, master bedroom and kitchen. One fan point in master bedroom. TV point in drawing room.

WATER SUPPLY

Round the clock water supply through sump and overhead tank. Drinking water drawn from KWA line in kitchen. Water to toilets/bathroom from well.

CAR PARK

Covered car parking at extra cost.

FIRE FIGHT

Government safety norms.

*All alterations at extra cost
